name: My submission history
description: The caller's own versions, private rows included. The session check cannot be a join inside the aggregate as it is on the other authed reads: json_agg with no GROUP BY returns one row whatever it is fed, so a revoked session would have got 200 and an empty list -- a rejection indistinguishable from having submitted nothing. live_sessions is therefore the outer FROM, which yields no row at all when the session is dead, and `deny` tests the `session_ok` marker rather than `body`, because an empty list is falsy.
